sloka: व्याघ्रो वराहो जीमूतः पर्वतः सागरो द्रुमः ।यक्षो दैत्यस्वरूपी च सो ऽदृश्यत दशाननः ।। ७.१५.३३ ॥
transliteration: vyāghro varāho jīmūtaḥ parvataḥ sāgaro drumaḥ ।yakṣo daityasvarūpī ca so 'dṛśyata daśānanaḥ ।। 7.15.33 ॥

translations.english: Dashanana was then seen in the forms of a tiger, a boar, a cloud, a mountain, an ocean, a tree, a Yaksha, and a Daitya.
